text:
tessa: Heads-up — PR 14821 is sitting at 1/2 LGTM and we hit the cutoff in 40m. Can someone take a quick second pass? Link: https://gh.redwood/PR/14821  

sam: I can eyeball it, but I'm on a call for the next 20m. If CI stays green I'll do a full pass after.  

miguel: I'm +1 on the change itself (checked the quantization shim). Quick question: did we update the feature flag rollout to 2-step? I don't see the flag toggle in the diff.  

tessa: good catch — I left the flag toggle out to avoid blowing the rollout window. Plan was: enable server-side check first then flip client flag in a patch. That said, we need a second approver to unblock the merge.  

sam: OK pinging now. @miguel can you confirm the rollout approach is safe? If so I'll give LGTM and land after smoke.  

miguel: Confirmed — server-side guard + canary for 10% is safe. I can add a tiny comment explaining the rollout in the PR description if that helps reviewers.  

tessa: please add that comment. Also CI flaky test flake on windows popped earlier but it's unrelated (mocks failing). We have a follow-up ticket.  

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR 14821 — build #872 green, unit + integration passed. (:white_check_mark:)  

oncall-ek: FYI I'm scheduled to merge anything that hits 2x LGTM within the next 30m cutover window. If you want me to hold the merge until post-canary, say so.  

tessa: thanks — prefer to merge and roll(canary) immediately, then monitor for 15m. If regressions, autobackout will kick at +20m.  

sam: reading now. small nits only, nothing blocking. leaving LGTM, will post comment in a min.  

miguel: added rollout note to PR description and a clarifying inline comment.  

sam: LGTM — go ahead.  
tessa: merged via `gh pr merge --squash 14821` at T-18m. Starting canary.  

deploy-bot: Release: canary rollout started for PR 14821 (10% traffic). Canary dashboard: https://ops/redwood/canary/14821  

oncall-ek: monitoring hooks set. I'll call it if we see error-rate spike > 0.5% or latency +30%.  

miguel: I'll watch logs for KV cache warnings.  

tessa: thanks y'all — appreciated quick turnaround :pray:  

sam: nice work, team.
